title: Draft: Add tap flag to reset listeners when epan memory is reset in tshark.
description: First use is by Export Object tap to prevent continual memory usage even when using -M flag

notes.body:
Because many times it's easier for me to talk at code than have several paragraphs of "design".  Here's a start of an idea to work towards #20432 , where taps can "opt in" to clean up their memory indirectly when -M is used by having new flags.
I still like the idea of current tap functionality being a "template design" and I don't really want taps "abusing" it (like I thought Export Object tap could just call eo_reset() at the end of eo_draw() to prevent the leak).  The idea here is that we can slowing "transition" all (tshark/cli) taps correctly.
Big picture, I think there are "full summary" (i.e. should be unaffected by -M) and "draw on demand" taps and I think we can use flags to distinguish them (and not add more function callbacks).  Unsure if there are other types that could also benefits from more flags.
